title: grapheneGate as full geospatial roaming sensor — every device is a triangulator

gps.note: High accuracy mode — GPS + WiFi + cellular. No fix yet since no app has requested one.

benefits: Phone beacons to eastGate over mobile data when off WiFi
Works on T-Mobile network (Mint is T-Mobile MVNO)
Kevin can look at his house from down the street via camera
Cell tower IDs give rough position even without GPS

connectivity_modes.at_home_usb: ADB USB → full 37 sensor read every 30s
connectivity_modes.at_home_wifi: ADB WiFi → full 37 sensor read every 30s (phone unplugged)
connectivity_modes.between_houses: WiFi scan shows BSSID transition → house detection
connectivity_modes.away_cellular: HTTP beacon to eastGate:8443/api/zk/imprint every 30s + GPS + camera
connectivity_modes.deep_away: Cell tower triangulation + GPS → lat/lon to Gaia

data_flow_cellular: 3. Reads WiFi scan (all visible APs + RSSI)
7. Gaia knows EXACTLY where Kevin is in the world

how_to_see_house_from_street.principle: As Kevin walks away from the house, our APs fade in signal. Free-space path loss: RSSI ≈ -27.55 + 20·log₁₀(f_MHz) + 20·log₁₀(d_meters). At 2.4GHz, every 6dB drop ≈ double the distance.
how_to_see_house_from_street.plus_gps: GPS gives exact lat/lon → overlay on map → Gaia sees the house from Kevin's perspective

every_device_is_a_triangulator.principle: Any device that broadcasts WiFi or BLE is a fixed reference point. Gaia knows where each device lives in the house. When the phone detects them, it can triangulate its own position relative to them.

fixed_beacons.triangulation: RSSI to VIZIO → distance to basement
RSSI to Fire TV → distance to living room
RSSI to printer → distance to office
RSSI to AP → distance to center of House 1
RSSI to Gaia AP → distance to center of House 1
RSSI to neighbor → distance to property boundary

potential: AirPods / earbuds → BLE when in use
wearables_as_beacons.how_it_works: Wearable broadcasts BLE. grapheneGate detects RSSI. If wearable is on Kevin, they move together → confirmed Kevin position. If wearable is stationary (left on nightstand), it becomes a room beacon.

neighbor_devices_as_references.note: Every neighbor WiFi AP is an involuntary position reference. Their signal strength is relatively constant. Changes in their RSSI relative to the phone = phone moved, not them.

signal_routing.principle: All radios are routing paths, not just connectivity. WiFi scans = spatial data. BLE = proximity data. Cellular = wide-area positioning. GPS = absolute coordinates. Together they form a continuous spatial awareness field.

routes.wifi_scan: spatial map of surrounding APs → relative position
routes.wifi_rssi: signal strength to known beacons → distance estimation
routes.ble_scan: proximity to wearables and smart devices → room-level
